name: 存储 / NFS Cache 节点缓存策略 / 单节点与跨页批量覆盖、默认值继承、离线重试、搜索筛选与非管理员拒绝
scope: Single targeted contract on an existing NFS-cache definition; not a storage-type or page completion claim
identity: admin browser for every mutation; a seeded role=user account for the read-only and refusal phase
fixture: isolated server and fresh SQLite; 25 offline node records (Cache node 01..25, rack a/b labels), one nfs_cache storage named e2e-<runId>-cache whose mount and cache paths sit under the isolated server's storage root (default 128 GiB, cache-node-01 unlimited, cache-node-02 64 GiB) and a role=user account are inserted into the isolated database before the browser starts; the product has no user-management API or UI, so the account is a seeded fact. Every tested change goes through the UI

runtime_evidence.reason: No agent is connected. The case does not claim a mount, cache eviction, trim execution or capacity report; the reconcile request is accepted intent only and the node stays offline.

checklist_items.1.1: On first open of the Cache node 01 cache settings drawer, the usage block is one small bordered description list. Its labels are the localized cached, protected, reclaimable, and disk-available sentences. Cached, protected, and reclaimable each show the localized usage-unknown sentence, and disk available shows the localized directory-not-verified sentence. Cache directory policy is three radios with Keep current configuration selected, Follow default directory and Use another directory unchecked. The cache directory value is a disabled text input whose absolute path is repeated by the localized default-directory sentence. Cache limit is one radiogroup named with the localized cache-limit sentence; Follow default and Custom are unchecked and Unlimited is selected. No spinbutton, unit combobox, addon, or checkbox is shown, and Save configuration is disabled. The localized budget sentence and the cached-models heading are visible, the model-details-unavailable sentence is absent, and there are no model rows. The same run then saves a custom 32 GiB limit: the node-overrides PATCH body is node cache-node-01 and cache_max_bytes 34359738368, the response is 200, and the independent GET stores that byte count. The following unlimited save sends cache_max_bytes 0 and the independent GET stores 0.
checklist_items.1.2: PARTIAL: single-node dialog prefill (unlimited, then 32 GiB) and the edit dialog after reload (unlimited default, node 02 at 64.0 GiB); MISSING: no submission before async load
checklist_items.1.3: On the Cache node 01 cache settings drawer, choosing Use another directory enables the cache directory value, which still shows an absolute path. Saving that directory empty shows the localized invalid-directory sentence, sends no node-overrides PATCH, leaves the node target at cache_max_bytes 0 with no cache_path field, and leaves the storage default directory unchanged. Saving a whitespace-only directory does the same. After both rejections the custom-directory radio stays selected, Keep current configuration and Follow default directory stay unchecked, and the cache-limit radios stay on Unlimited with Follow default and Custom unchecked.
checklist_items.1.9: covered: While the defaults PATCH is held a forced second click and Enter send no further save, and the later 200 is the only stored default
checklist_items.1.10: A real second browser context saves the default limit 128→96→128 GiB while the first defaults editor retains its unlimited draft and old revision. The first save returns real HTTP 409 STORAGE_CONFIG_CHANGED; the localized conflict alert, unlimited draft and original directory remain. Independent GET keeps the other writer revision and the complete original policy. Reopening loads custom 128 GiB and the saved directory with no stale error. Saving unlimited with the current expected_updated_at returns 200 and advances the revision; independent GET and reloaded node details show unlimited inheritance while the 64 GiB exception and all unrelated identity/path/target fields remain unchanged.
checklist_items.1.11: The single-node cache drawer shows one close button. Cancel, that close button, and Escape each close the drawer, send no storage write, and show no unsaved-changes prompt. The batch dialog and the defaults dialog each do the same for Cancel, the close button, and Escape. After every one of those dismissals the independent GET keeps the same default limit, default directory, and the same Cache node 01 and Cache node 02 limits and directories that were saved before that dismissal.
checklist_items.1.12: Node 01 changes unlimited→custom 32→unlimited 0→batch 16→inherit; node 02 keeps 64 GiB through every other edit
checklist_items.1.13: While the defaults editor is open, a separate browser context changes the default limit from 128 to 96 and back to 128 GiB through two real UI PATCH requests and independently reads both values. Its new revision makes the first editor stale. That editor sends the frozen expected_updated_at, gets 409 STORAGE_CONFIG_CHANGED, retains its draft and localized recovery notice, and leaves every saved field unchanged. Reloading the page and reopening the defaults editor loads the saved policy and current revision; a subsequent UI save returns 200, independently persists unlimited and is rendered after reload.
checklist_items.1.14: PARTIAL: every mutation is read back by an independent GET; the table is reloaded after the 32 GiB, unlimited-0, inherit-null and defaults changes. The batch-16 change is GET-only; agent effect is N/A (no agent)
checklist_items.1.15: The five cache metric controls are block buttons. In the Cache node 01 cache settings drawer, Tab from the close button reaches the selected directory policy, then the selected limit, then Cancel. Enter in the directory field sends no storage write and leaves the directory unchanged. Saving an empty directory shows the localized invalid-directory alert and sends no storage write. At 1440x900 the directory field, Cancel, and Save are each inside the viewport, and the directory field does not overlap Cancel or Save. After that check the independent GET keeps the same default limit, default directory, and the same Cache node 01 and Cache node 02 limits and directories.
checklist_items.3.1: Switching a node to a custom cache limit shows an empty amount. The unit shown is GiB, and the choices are GiB and TiB, so this field is a byte capacity. The spinbutton step is 1 and its minimum is 0. The control has no maximum, no percent suffix and no slider. Closing the unit list leaves GiB selected. None of that sends a request, and the independent read stays at 0 bytes
checklist_items.3.2: 0, an empty value and a non-numeric entry blur to an empty custom limit, and -1 does the same. Save on each shows the invalid-limit alert, sends no node-overrides request, and the independent read stays at 0 bytes. 1 GiB is the smallest whole GiB that stays displayed, and 1.5 GiB stays displayed. 8388607 GiB is the largest whole GiB whose byte count is a safe integer and it stays displayed. 8388608 GiB stays displayed and Save rejects it, with the stored limit still at 0 bytes
checklist_items.3.3: The custom cache limit changes2-to3-to2 through actual ArrowUp/ArrowDown and visible Increase/Decrease buttons. The single unit selector changes1024GiB-to1TiB-to1024GiB and2GiB-to0.001953125TiB-to2GiB, including blur without fractional truncation. Decrementing1 follows the actual empty invalid-input state. Exactly one spinbutton and no slider are present; no node-overrides PATCH occurs and the independent saved byte value remains unchanged. This is a control/step/unit check, not a claim that the fractional draft was saved or executed.
checklist_items.3.4: Whole browser request bodies are compared as canonical JSON, preserving distinctions among integer bytes, floats, strings, empty strings, booleans, null,0 and omitted fields. Saving32GiB requires integer34359738368; unlimited sends integer0, restore-to-inherit sends explicit null, and unchanged limit fields are omitted for applicable path-only updates. Independent GET and reopened controls confirm the applicable saved meanings. Ordinary Python equality cannot accept false or0.0 in place of integer0.
checklist_items.3.5: GiB input is sent in bytes and rendered back as 32.0 GiB / 64.0 GiB / 128.0 GiB

checklist_items.11.5: covered: The batch buttons act on the selection, so selection is driven directly. Both are disabled with nothing selected and both enable on the first tick. A second row joins the set instead of replacing it, and unticking the first leaves the second and keeps the batch action available. Select-all is page-scoped rather than set-scoped: with 22 nodes across 3 pages it ticks the 20 on the page, not 22. Under a search that narrows the list to 11 rows it ticks 9 and never reaches the 11 the filter excluded, and the selection alert names both scopes ("9 nodes selected" / "Select all 9 filtered nodes") so the count the operator is choosing is visible before acting. Clear selection empties the set - zero boxes stay ticked - and the batch action returns to disabled.
checklist_items.11.7: PARTIAL: the selection set is what the batch buttons act on, and clearing it returns them to disabled; retention when moving between pages, after filtering, or after a reload is not established, and the batch request body is not inspected
checklist_items.12.1: Single-node, batch and defaults dialogs open from their triggers with names that carry the node or count
checklist_items.12.2: covered: Defaults dialog at 1440x900: the dialog and footer Save configuration stay inside the viewport, and the title, body and footer sit inside the dialog without overlap
checklist_items.12.3: covered: Default focus is inside the defaults dialog. Tab and Shift+Tab each cycle across at least two controls and never leave the dialog
checklist_items.12.4: covered: Cancel, Escape and the close button each send no storage write, keep the storage detail drawer open, and return focus to the control that opened the editor. Both the node editor (Configure) and the batch editor (Batch configure) are checked for all three dismissals, and the focused element's text is recorded so the target is the real trigger and not merely some element inside the drawer. The mask dismissal is checked separately on the defaults dialog through the shared nested-dismissal helper; the node and batch editors do not set maskClosable, so the mask path is covered there rather than duplicated. This required a product fix: the editor was mounted conditionally, so returning from onClose unmounted the subtree before the drawer's close transition ran and antd never restored focus - it landed on the body after cancel, close and escape alike. The editor now closes in two steps, flipping open to false and only unmounting after afterOpenChange reports the transition finished. Proven by reverting that fix: the case then fails with 'node editor left focus outside the detail drawer after: [cancel, close, escape]'.
checklist_items.12.5: N/A: the defaults dialog has no nested child layer
checklist_items.12.6: While the real stale defaults PATCH is held before sending, Save is disabled and a forced second click plus Enter send no duplicate. Releasing that request reaches the real server and returns 409 STORAGE_CONFIG_CHANGED; the unlimited limit and directory draft remain with the localized conflict reason. Reopening with the fresh revision and saving returns 200, matches independent GET and the refreshed effective limit. No management API response is mocked.
checklist_items.12.7: MISSING: clear-cache confirmation is not exercised; every seeded node is offline
checklist_items.12.8: The defaults dialog sends the previewed expected_updated_at. After another writer advances the revision, Save returns 409 STORAGE_CONFIG_CHANGED, the unlimited draft and cache path stay in the open dialog, and the independent GET keeps the previous default limit and the other writer's revision. Teardown is not the assertion
checklist_items.13.3: The role=user session sees no configure, batch, restore, retry, defaults, clear or edit-scope control and no checkbox; its PATCH node-overrides, PATCH storage, POST cache/reconcile and DELETE cache are each refused with 403 ADMINISTRATOR_REQUIRED, and targets, updated_at and the default are unchanged
checklist_items.3.6: The control and the server refuse the same lower bound. The form blurs -1 to empty and shows the invalid-limit alert without sending anything, and a PATCH written straight to /api/v1/storages/{id}/node-overrides with cache_max_bytes -1 and then -1073741824 is refused with HTTP 400 and code STORAGE_CACHE_LIMIT_NEGATIVE. Independent readback after both refusals still shows the stored limit at 0 bytes, so a rejected capacity left the configuration untouched.
checklist_items.10.5: covered: The node table pages at 20 of 25 nodes and the size changer offers exactly PAGE_SIZE_OPTIONS ([10,20,50,100], read from the rendered dropdown). Choosing 10 reduces the rendered data rows from 20 to 10; choosing 20 restores 20. Rows are counted on tr[data-row-key] because antd also renders a zero-height measure row and an expansion placeholder, and counting .ant-table-row overcounts - a fact this check surfaced rather than assumed.
checklist_items.10.6: covered: With 10 per page the table has 3 pages over 25 nodes and every navigation control is live: jumping to the last page shows the 5 remaining nodes, previous returns to a full 10, next returns to the 5 and marks item 3 active, and item 1 returns to 10. Controls are resolved inside the cache management region because the page carries more than one paged table. The size is then restored to 20 and the row count matches the starting count.
checklist_items.10.9: covered: Every one of the 20 rows on the page is opened by its own node name, never by position, and each expanded detail is a definition list carrying at least three labelled terms with filled values, then closed again by its own control. All 20 round-trip, so no row is present but unopenable. The sweep reuses the case's existing open/close helper rather than a second spelling of it - hand-written selectors for this table were where the earlier attempts went wrong, because antd inserts the expanded row into the tbody and shifts any index-based locator. Kill: replacing the detail's <dt> term with a <span> makes the sweep report 'the detail for Cache node 01 rendered 0 labelled fields'.
